c6-intake-lifter-check-spring.name: Lifter check-valve spring

c6-intake-lifter-lock-ring.name: Lifter retaining ring

c6-intake-lifter-metering-disc.name: Lifter metering disc

c6-intake-lifter-plunger.name: Lifter plunger

c6-intake-lifter-plunger-spring.name: Lifter plunger spring
c6-intake-lifter-plunger-spring.function: Biases the plunger outward during lash adjustment.

c6-intake-lifter-pushrod-cup.name: Lifter pushrod cup
c6-intake-lifter-pushrod-cup.function: Supports the spherical pushrod end and admits lubricating oil.

c6-intake-rocker-bolt.function: Retains the fulcrum on the threaded head pedestal.

camshaft.name: Camshaft
camshaft.function: Twelve lobes time the intake and exhaust valves. Four bearing journals locate the shaft; the timing gears turn it once per two crankshaft revolutions.

crank-timing-gear.name: Crank Timing Gear
crank-timing-gear.function: The direct gear mesh maintains a 2:1 crank-to-cam speed ratio. These are 20-degree involute teaching gears; tooth count and pitch are not verified for the truck.

crankshaft.name: Crankshaft
crankshaft.function: Six throws turn reciprocating piston force into rotation. The seven main journals support the shaft; paired throws follow the 1–5–3–6–2–4 firing order.

cylinder-head.name: Cylinder head
cylinder-head.function: Closes the cylinders and carries the valves, intake and exhaust passages and rocker supports. Port and chamber shapes here are provisional.

efi-upper-intake.name: Upper EFI intake manifold
efi-upper-intake.function: A common plenum distributes air into six curved runners feeding the lower manifold. The catalog lists E7TZ9424A. This is one casting, not six removable runner tubes. The throttle-body interface is open; a separate throttle mechanism mounts at this interface.

egr-exhaust-tube.name: EGR exhaust tube
egr-exhaust-tube.function: Carries exhaust from the rear manifold to the valve inlet. End construction and routing remain a fit study.

head-gasket.name: Head gasket
head-gasket.function: Seals combustion, coolant and oil interfaces between block and head. Fire rings and passage pattern need further evidence.

ignition-lead-6-carbon-core.name: Ignition lead 6 carbon core
ignition-lead-6-carbon-core.function: Aggregate carbon-impregnated fiber conductor carries the secondary ignition signal. Individual fibers, resistance and voltage are not simulated.

ignition-lead-6-jacket.name: Ignition lead 6 jacket
ignition-lead-6-jacket.function: Hollow rubber insulation surrounds the separate carbon core. Route and diameter are provisional.

ignition-lead-6-plug-boot.name: Ignition lead 6 plug boot
ignition-lead-6-plug-boot.function: Separate insulating boot encloses the terminal and cable entry. Production contour and sealing compression remain unverified.

ignition-lead-6-plug-contact.name: Ignition lead 6 plug contact
ignition-lead-6-plug-contact.function: Conductive terminal cup joins the cable core to its coil, cap or plug contact. Clip construction and dimensions are provisional.

oil-pan.name: Oil pan
oil-pan.function: Stores returning oil in a deeper rear sump. The forward section clears the crankcase region; transition and flange geometry remain provisional. Drain dimensions beyond the published thread, sealing details and the pickup-to-floor interface remain provisional.

oil-pan-molded-gasket.name: Continuous molded pan gasket study
oil-pan-molded-gasket.function: A continuous seal crosses both long rails and the front/rear end bridges. Shape is a provisional interface study informed by the exact replacement image.

pushrod-cover.name: Pushrod side cover
pushrod-cover.function: Closes the block-side access opening beside the pushrods and lifters. Stamped ribs stiffen the thin cover.

pushrod-cover-gasket.name: Pushrod cover perimeter gasket
pushrod-cover-gasket.function: Seals the perimeter where the cover meets the block. This is separate from the six fastener grommets.

pushrod-cover-grommet-1.name: Cover bolt grommet 1
pushrod-cover-grommet-1.function: Seals around one cover fastener. The modeled rubber section is an uncompressed replacement-envelope study.

spark-plug-6-center-electrode.name: Spark-plug center electrode · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-center-electrode.function: The firing end faces the ground strap across the specified application gap. Electrode construction is illustrative.

spark-plug-6-copper-core.name: Spark-plug electrode core · illustrative · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-copper-core.function: Illustrates a separate heat-conducting electrode core; WR4-1 internal dimensions remain unverified.

spark-plug-6-ground-electrode.name: Spark-plug ground electrode · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-ground-electrode.function: The ground strap returns spark current through the shell to the cylinder head. Its gap is modeled at .044 inch.

spark-plug-6-insulator.name: Spark-plug ceramic insulator · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-insulator.function: Isolates the center conductor from the grounded shell. Nose and corrugation dimensions are provisional.

spark-plug-6-lower-seal.name: Spark-plug lower conductive seal · illustrative · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-lower-seal.function: Illustrates an internal conducting seal between electrode and resistor.

spark-plug-6-resistor.name: Spark-plug suppressor resistor · illustrative · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-resistor.function: Represents the internal interference-suppression element; resistance and construction are not specified by this model.

spark-plug-6-shell.name: Spark-plug threaded metal shell · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-shell.function: Seats in the head and carries the ground electrode. A helical thread replaces the smooth envelope; pitch is family-derived and production thread tolerances remain unverified.

spark-plug-6-terminal.name: Spark-plug terminal and stem · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-terminal.function: Receives the plug-wire connection and carries voltage toward the internal resistor.

spark-plug-6-upper-seal.name: Spark-plug upper conductive seal · illustrative · cylinder 6
spark-plug-6-upper-seal.function: Illustrates an internal conducting seal between resistor and terminal stem.

valve-cover.name: Valve cover
valve-cover.function: Contains oil around the rocker gear. Sloped shoulders and separate oil-fill/ventilation openings replace the box envelope. Exact stamping contours, mounting holes, baffles and opening stations remain provisional.

valve-cover-gasket.name: Valve cover gasket
valve-cover-gasket.function: Seals the rocker cover to the head. Bolt-hole pattern and corner radii are pending.
